why: weak.txt holds strings the campaign uses that legitimate projects use too, so a match is a line to review and never a finding of infection. The CI scanner and the GitHub check have always said so; the folder and computer checks never read the list, which ioc/README.md promised they did. A weak string in ordinary source is review, exit 1. The same string in documentation or in an ioc/ list is the operator's own detection material, set aside as the GitHub check sets it aside, so it adds nothing (ADR-0047).

findings.match: mentions something the campaign also uses
